subject: [hw] DONE V15 rev 4: R1 finding F3 (two GE bits per halfword lane) fixed
body:
Rev 4 of V15 (T32 32-bit data processing). No interface change.

1. hw-r1 finding F3 fixed: the halfword parallel add/sub forms now drive a two-bit GE field per lane (GE<1:0> low halfword, GE<3:2> high halfword, both bits equal when the exact lane condition holds, 00 otherwise). Byte lanes keep one bit each. R1s repro is a unit case: sadd16 r0,r1,r2 (FA91F002), r1=0x0001FFFF, r2=0x00010001 -> r0=0x00020000, GE=0xF; plus uadd16 with both lanes carrying -> GE=0xF. All 16-bit GE expectations in the suite were re-derived.

2. Package test:
    $ bash gpu/hwcodec/emu/test_v15/run_tests.sh
    N2TEST V15 PASS 1616/1616
    (ASan+UBSan -O1, then -O2.)

3. R1s own spot suite on the current tree: `bash gpu/hwcodec/review/r1/run_spot.sh` -> R1-SPOT 180/183; the three failures are V14 T16 items (mov pc, cbz/cbnz), none in the V15 section, so F1/F2/F3 all pass in the reviewer build.

4. Optional real-core routing check unchanged:
    $ bash gpu/hwcodec/emu/test_v15/check_routing.sh
    V15-ROUTE PASS 10/10

Not done unchanged: no phone; T01 corpus thumb rows still need V16; ADC/SBC-with-modified-immediate cannot be assembled by llvm-mc; parallel GE is now per the review but still not exercised by vendor code.

Files (mine): gpu/hwcodec/emu/n2a32_t32_dp.c, gpu/hwcodec/emu/test_v15/{run_tests.sh,gen_enc.py,vectors.s,t_dp.c,check_routing.sh,k15_t32_dp.c,STATUS.md}, gpu/hwcodec/dsh-state/workers/V15/STATUS.md.
